purpose: Evidence inventory for future parity checks during triage consolidation. These records are not runtime inputs.

rules.current_outcome: Ranks emergency above doctor_today above doctor_24_48 above monitor.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Determines which deterministic triage rule outcome wins when several rules match.

rules.current_outcome: emergency and doctor_today map to urgent; doctor_24_48 maps to routine; monitor maps to monitor.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Converts internal next-step level to the public urgency string saved and displayed by reports.

rules.current_outcome: Produces the deterministic next-step labels for each level.
rules.current_behavior_summary: This overlaps route-level fallback next-step wording in server/routes/triage.ts.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for chest warning signs; otherwise same-day doctor advice for new or unexplained chest discomfort.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Chest path has emergency and doctor_today rules plus profile modifiers for heart, BP, stroke, and diabetes history.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for major pain red flags; same-day advice for fall-related pain, new headache after 50, night back pain, or deformity.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Pain path includes blood thinner, stroke, and hypertension profile modifiers.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for high-risk breathing warning signs; same-day advice for worse breathing, fever/cough, lying-flat worsening, or new/worsening symptoms.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Breathing path includes heart and pulmonary profile modifiers.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for fever warning signs; same-day advice for high, prolonged, uncertain, worsening, infection-linked, low-urine, or severe fever patterns.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Fever path includes low-immunity, cancer treatment, steroid, and recent surgery profile modifiers.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for unresolved fainting, stroke-like signs, chest pain, breathing trouble, or unsafe walking; same-day advice for fall risk, standing/head-movement dizziness, strong, worse, or new symptoms.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Dizziness path includes diabetes, kidney disease, diuretic, and sedating medication profile modifiers.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for stroke-like, unsafe standing, alertness, breathing/sedation, or glucose danger signs; same-day advice for infection, poor intake, strong, worse, or new weakness.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Tired path includes heart, diabetes, kidney, opioid, and sedating medication modifiers.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for severe belly, blood/black stool, blocked urine/stool/gas, collapse, or rigid belly; same-day or 24-48 hour follow-up for lower-risk persistent patterns.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Stomach path includes blood thinner, kidney disease, and diuretic profile modifiers.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for blocked urine, heavy bleeding, or new confusion/marked weakness; same-day advice for fever/flank pain/blood/catheter/severe or worsening symptoms; 24-48 hour advice for mild persistent symptoms.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Urinary path includes diabetes, kidney disease, UTI history, cognition risk, and diuretic profile modifiers.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for head-hit red flags, confusion, inability to stand, deformity, heavy bleeding, or hip/back pain; same-day advice for blood thinner head hit, loss of consciousness, fall from height, alone after fall, or worsening; 24-48 hour advice for moderate injury.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Fall path includes blood thinner, frailty, osteoporosis, and sedating medication profile modifiers.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for swelling, whole-body infection signs, or non-fading rash; same-day advice for spreading wound, fever after surgery, shingles risks, pus, strong, worse, or new skin symptoms.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Skin path includes low immunity, cancer, steroid, diabetes, and recent surgery profile modifiers.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for sudden/new confusion, hard-to-wake, stroke, urine/infection/glucose danger, or self-harm concern; same-day advice for unsafe, medicine-related, persistent, or changing confusion; 24-48 hour advice for slow mild memory/thinking changes.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Confusion path includes cognition, diabetes, kidney, sedating, and opioid profile modifiers.

rules.current_outcome: Emergency for unclear symptom with serious warning signs; same-day advice for new/worse/high-risk area or poor intake; 24-48 hour advice for unclear or non-improving symptoms.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Other path is the fallback symptom protocol.

rules.current_outcome: Returns an urgent safety support response before the LLM path unless refinement is requested.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Route-level emergency gate overlaps the deterministic hasCriticalRedFlag rule input.

rules.current_outcome: Raises the deterministic decision to emergency.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Canonical deterministic equivalent of the route-level safety gate.

rules.current_outcome: Computes fallback nextStepLevel and nextStepLabel from summary urgency and selected answers.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Duplicates next-step label ownership that also exists in triageRules labelFor.

rules.current_outcome: Applies deterministic triage rule output, vitals notes, profile notes, and optional scan overlay to an AI-generated summary.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Core route-level orchestration point for deterministic safety floor.

rules.current_outcome: Urgent optional scan results add a clinician-today reason and recommendation.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Optional scan overlay can raise urgency but does not downgrade emergency findings.

rules.current_outcome: Raises public urgency to at least urgent for urgent optional scan results.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Scan-based urgency floor must be preserved during consolidation.

rules.current_outcome: Raises next step to at least doctor_today when urgent scan exists and rules are below doctor_today.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Urgent optional scan does not become emergency by itself.

rules.current_outcome: Offers optional scan types after red-flag questions when not loading, not in safety alert, not completed, not declined, and not blocked by emergency IDs.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Client-side offer routing uses symptom and answer IDs that overlap deterministic triage concepts.

rules.current_outcome: Returns appearance-only JSON with concernLevel, summary, and findings; fallback concernLevel is watch.
rules.current_behavior_summary: AI scan route enriches optional triage context but is not deterministic clinical rule storage.

rules.current_outcome: Builds profile risk flags from health memory text.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Risk flag inference is route-owned today and feeds deterministic triage rules.

rules.current_outcome: Raises level when path-specific profile risk modifiers match.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Protocol profile modifiers are currently embedded beside symptom path rules.

rules.current_outcome: Raises fever with low-immunity risk to doctor_today.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Global profile overlay outside per-path protocol array.

rules.current_outcome: Raises breathing, tired, dizzy, fall, or confusion patterns with heart/breathing history to doctor_today.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Global profile overlay outside per-path protocol array.

rules.current_outcome: Raises selected dizzy, tired, fever, urinary, stomach, confusion, or other patterns to doctor_today.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Global profile overlay outside per-path protocol array.

rules.current_outcome: Raises selected pain, dizzy, fall, confusion, or other patterns to doctor_today.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Global profile overlay outside per-path protocol array.

rules.current_outcome: Inserts caregiverAlerts triage_report record when a GP or caregiver recipient exists.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Report delivery side effect uses triage urgency as stored severity.
rules.proposed_owner: server/routes adapter with shared caregiver helper

rules.current_outcome: Statuses at or above share_with_caregiver are eligible for caregiver escalation.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Daily Safety caregiver escalation threshold is separate from symptom triage urgency.

rules.current_outcome: Computes deterministic Daily Safety status, recommended_action, risk tier, senior message, caregiver note, and contributing signals.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Daily Safety is not symptom triage and should be owned by src/safety after extraction.

rules.current_outcome: Records or reuses a caregiver alert for escalating Daily Safety status when consent and recipients allow it.
rules.current_behavior_summary: Route owns persistence, consent lookup, recipient lookup, duplicate window, and alert insert.

rules.current_outcome: Validates saved triage report payload including optional scan and vitals note fields.
rules.current_behavior_summary: API contract must be preserved during consolidation.
